Basis on the bytes of Ezek_web_clean.txt (a7e59bcb): WEB 8:6 ends 'But you will again see yet other great abominations.”' and P02-001 writes “you will again see yet other great abominations,” - the verse's words with a trailing comma for its period; 8:7 opens 'He brought me to the door of the court;' and P02-002 writes “he brought me to the door of the court” - sentence-initial case; 8:8 'Son of man, dig now in the wall.' against “son of man, dig now in the wall”; 9:11 'I have done as you have commanded me.”' against “I have done as you have commanded me,”; 10:9 'The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.' against “the appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone”; 11:6 'You have multiplied your slain' against “you have multiplied your slain” (P02-008 refs[1]).
